 Print Love Gill ’s equation with ScoutOP has been a talking point among Bigg Boss 20 viewers, with their growing closeness inviting criticism both inside and outside the house. Amid the ongoing controversy, Kamya Punjabi has now taken a dig at Love after a video of her spending time with Gullu surfaced on social media. ScoutOP and Love have been facing questions over their bond, particularly after Salman Khan addressed the situation during Weekend Ka Vaar. The host had questioned Scout about his confusion regarding his feelings towards Love. The matter also gained attention after Scout’s girlfriend, Kashish Hirnandani, entered the show and asked him to distance himself from Love. Despite the intervention, Scout and Love continued to share a close bond, drawing reactions from viewers. Salman once again pulled up Scout over the situation during the latest Weekend Ka Vaar episode. Following the episode, the two were reportedly not seen sitting together or interacting as they had earlier. Watch From Riya Ahir, Mahhi Vij to Qazi Touqeer, here’s the contestant lineup for Bigg Boss 20 Meanwhile, videos of Love spending time with Gullu have been circulating on social media. In the clips, Love can be seen playing with him, with the two sharing some light-hearted moments. Reacting to these videos, Kamya took a sarcastic dig at Love and wrote, “Sis’s new target… oops, who’s the new BROTHER, tell meeee. Who’s sis’s new mom, tell meeee. The one who was left speechless in front of Salman yesterday, but today Qazi fans, sorry but no sorry, you’ll have to answer for what you said, won’t youuuu. What do you say, Qazi’s fans ???” Join conversation

 Her remark also brought Qazi’s fans into the conversation, with several users responding to her post. One user wrote, “Mam usko pata h uska koi game h hi nhi. Ab qazi bhai se ladh k dikhna chahti h. Or jo sorry but no sorry boli h na usko hm qazi fans uski aukat bata dege.. aapka bht thanku aap qazi bhai ko start se support krte aa rahe ho.” Another user praised Kamya’s views on the show and its contestants, writing, “Mam you are always on point. You are the only celebrity whom we can relate so much because your views about Bigg Boss and its contestants are similar to ours.” Kamya’s reaction has added another layer to the ongoing discussion around Love, Scout and the other contestants, with Qazi’s fans also joining the conversation.
